title: Search Engine
author: PJ Vogt
description: We try to make sense of the world, one question at a time. No question too big, no question too small.Hosted by PJ Vogt, edited by Sruthi Pinnamaneni. Named one of the best podcasts of all time by Time Magazine

episodes_recents.titre: The Killing of the Gaza Chef
A road trip through the data center debate

extraits.texte: I knew I missed Reply All, but I didn’t quite know how much I had missed it until I heard PJ giggle again on Search Engine. Like Reply All, this show is cheerful and smart.…
Great episode, all the stuff I instinctively thought about what warnings do or don’t help has been confirmed.
Un podcast anglophone qui creuse des sujets originaux. La narration et la production sont de qualité.
